A Shared Vision

Tuva and OpenSciEd share a fundamental belief: to do science as scientists, students must have the power to follow their own curiosity. While OpenSciEd provides a high-quality, inquiry-based framework for science learning, Tuva provides the specialized tools to bring that inquiry to life through the lens of data.

How The Tuva OpenSciEd Companion Enhances OSE

Streamlines Instruction

If a lesson in OSE involves data, then Tuva has digitized and optimized it using our drag-and-drop data visualization tools. That means less class time spent drawing axes or plotting data, and less time copying and shuffling paper during prep.

Refocuses Energy on Sensemaking

With the mechanics of graphing out of the way, students can spend their cognitive energy on what matters: making sense of data, exploring representations, and deepening science ideas—not performing time-consuming, rote procedures.

Empowers Inquiry

Tuva's intuitive tools let students explore complex data with an agility spreadsheets can't match. Students can instantly swap variables and experiment with visualization types, evolving their analysis as quickly as new questions arise.

Deepens Data Practices

Tuva elevates student work from rote plotting to professional data practices. By manipulating complex datasets, students learn to navigate uncertainty and use mathematical modeling to investigate phenomena just like real scientists.

What does The Tuva OSE Companion include?

The Tuva OpenSciEd Companion is a targeted enhancement rather than a full curriculum, specifically designed to bolster the data-intensive portions of the curriculum without requiring a full platform overhaul. Tuva "infuses" into the daily workflow of an OSE classroom, providing a digital bridge between raw observations and meaningful explanations.

Streamlined Investigations

Digitized OSE Worksheets and Data Tables

The heart of OpenSciEd is the student-led investigation. Traditionally, students record their findings on paper or in digital documents that don't allow for easy data manipulation. We have digitized the OSE investigation worksheets and data tables to streamline the scientific process:

  • Direct Data Input: Students can input the data they collect during OSE labs directly into a custom Tuva interface that mirrors their curriculum worksheets.
  • Instant Analysis: As soon as data is entered, it becomes an interactive dataset. Students can immediately visualize their own classroom findings.
  • Reduced Cognitive Load: By automating the mechanical tasks of graphing, students focus on sensemaking—the why behind the science.

Dynamic Data Lessons

OSE Static Data Tables and Graphs, Now Interactive

In the standard open-source version of OpenSciEd, students often interact with static tables in PDFs. Tuva transforms these into dynamic learning environments:

  • Interactive Visualization: Students instantly sort, filter, and color-code data to uncover hidden patterns.
  • Multi-Dimensional Tools: Pivot between dot plots, line graphs, bar charts, pie charts, box plots, histograms, and maps with one click.
  • Evidence-Based Explanations: Students can easily submit their visualizations to include as evidence in their CER (Claim, Evidence, Reasoning) statements.

Single Sign-On (SSO):

Students and teachers can log in instantly using their existing school credentials via Google, Clever, or ClassLink.

LMS Syncing:

Effortlessly assign Tuva-OSE activities and sync rosters with Google Classroom, Canvas, and Schoology.

Cross-Platform Accessibility:

Tuva is a web-based platform that works beautifully on Chromebooks, iPads, laptops, and interactive whiteboards, requiring no software installations or complex setups.

Accessibility & Equity: Data Literacy and Science for All

OpenSciEd and Tuva share a commitment to inclusive science education.

Inclusion by Design:

Built on Universal Design for Learning (UDL) principles to provide multiple modes of engagement and scaffolded learning paths.

Technical Standards:

WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance, featuring keyboard navigation, screen-reader compatibility, and high-contrast displays.

Language Support:

Supports 10+ languages and includes translation widgets to support English Language Learners (ELLs).

Financial Equity:

We offer intentionally affordable pricing, with specific tiers for schools utilizing the open-source (OER) version of OSE.
